title: Synthesizing Health Advice: érdemes, ajánlott, tanácsos

sections.title: Gentle advisory predicates with infinitives
sections.content: You know *érdemes* and *ajánlott* with the infinitive from A2 (Unit 18, advice with *kellene*, *érdemes*, *ajánlott*). New here is *tanácsos* (it is advisable), which works the same way.

items.spanish: Évente legalább egyszer érdemes elmenni orvosi vizsgálatra.
items.english: At least once a year, it is worthwhile to go for a medical checkup.

items.spanish: A gyors gyógyulás érdekében ajánlott ágyban maradni.
items.english: In the interest of rapid recovery, it is recommended to stay in bed.
